title: Warm Crisp Brazilian Flour Flatbread
description: A fresh and crisp Brazilian dish featuring strong white flour, perfect for a snack or light meal, made without onions or garlic for a friendly flavor
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, salt, and sugar to combine.
Add the eggs, milk, and melted butter to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook each flatbread for 2 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden.
Repeat with the remaining dough pieces.
Serve the flatbreads warm, garnished with a sprinkle of sugar if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
